The paper "Anode-Free Sodium Battery through in Situ Plating of Sodium Metal" measures the sodium nucleation overpotential on aluminum current collectors. 

According to the paper, the sodium nucleation overpotential on a bare Al current collector is 19 mV, and on a carbon/Al current collector, it is 12 mV. Therefore, the carbon layer lowers the sodium nucleation overpotential by 7 mV.
